_doc: The buildings (D.STRUCTURES is the loaded view of `types`). Per type: name, desc (texts); wood, stone (cost); work (build points); r (footprint radius; ring: a wall around the village, sized by the player); cap (people it houses and shelters); food, lore (a trickle per second); tech (needed to build). hazards: what can knock it down (lightning, wildfire, flood, quake). open: flat ground people can stand on (fields, fires, graves). decor: art can decorate it. styled: it takes a new look per era. drift: culture drift (evo) when it is finished. inside_def: DEF for people inside the ring. sight: how far it reveals the land (default 200, a bonfire 300). lookout: it calls out war bands and wolf packs it sees (spots: the alerts, %s = the clan). effects: effect stats while one of its type stands and is ours (as on inventions; one counts, more do not add). build_menu: what the village build menu offers, in order. contract_builds: what a Task Contract may build. aliases: other names an LLM may use for a type.

hut.name: Hut
hut.desc: Houses 3 people. At night 3 sleep inside, warm and safe from wolves.

large_hut.name: Large Hut
large_hut.desc: Houses 5 people, and 5 can sleep inside at night.

palisade.name: Wooden Palisade
palisade.desc: A ring of stakes: people inside it get +3 DEF. Floods can't wash it away.

fishing_dock.name: Fishing Dock
fishing_dock.desc: Steady food from the river (less in winter).

bonfire.name: Bonfire
bonfire.desc: Warmth: nobody near it freezes, the sick heal faster, and those who don't fit in huts sleep around it. Lights up the land around it.

weapon_rack.name: Weapon Rack
weapon_rack.desc: People near it fight with +20% ATK.

totem_shrine.name: Totem Shrine
totem_shrine.desc: A trickle of lore. Rituals near it give 50% more lore, and the sick nearby heal faster.

farm_plot.name: Farm Plot
farm_plot.desc: Steady food from the field (none in winter, less in drought).

granary.name: Granary
granary.desc: Stores 100 more food (food over the stores' limit rots fast). Houses 4 people, and gatherers drop food here, so build it near the fields.

grand_altar.name: Grand Altar
grand_altar.desc: Summons Yinglong the winged dragon to guard the village. Rituals and healing as a shrine. Needed for Victory by Wisdom.

aurochs_pen.name: Aurochs Pen
aurochs_pen.desc: Home to up to 2 pack oxen. Each ox eats food and needs tending, and lets one gatherer carry 50% more.

smelter.name: Bronze Smelter
smelter.desc: Arms the tribe in bronze (+60% ATK, +3 DEF) while it has copper and tin; it uses one of each per day.

council_ring.name: Council Ring
council_ring.desc: A trickle of lore. Where the chiefs of the clans can meet: needed for Victory by Unity.

lookout_tower.name: Lookout Tower
lookout_tower.desc: Sees far over the land, and calls out war bands and wolf packs as soon as they come into sight. Built by a ford, it sees raiders long before they reach the village; alone out there, it is the first thing they find.

spots.raid: The lookout tower sees a war band of the %s on the march!
spots.wolves: The lookout tower sees a wolf pack on the prowl.

smokehouse.name: Smokehouse
smokehouse.desc: Racks over a slow fire: stored food rots at 60% of the speed (one is enough). Worth the most if it stands before the winter.

roadworks.name: Road works
roadworks.desc: A road being laid, stretch by stretch.

burial_ground.name: Burial Ground
burial_ground.desc: Where the tribe lays its dead to rest.
